config.notes: Charles Sturt (wave run 5 Oct). Page kinds: (1) international course pages study.csu.edu.au/international/courses/<slug> (static HTML, read direct/Firecrawl): 'Study mode and sessions' block lists 'Session N : <Month d, yyyy> <mode> <campuses>' (intakes = months of those dates, pick all; campus = text after first session's mode); 'Duration Minimum time - N year(s)'; 'Indicative fees International on campus Fee paying overseas: Full-time - $X pa' (fee = first, the on-campus full-time annual figure; online and part-time figures follow and are not read); 'AQF: Level N'; 'Cricos: <code>'; IELTS only where the page prints 'IELTS [results] (academic module) with a minimum overall score of N' (most pages defer to the central entry-requirements page). (2) central fee tables: www.csu.edu.au/current-students/financial-and-scholarship/fees/course-fees/international-students (2027 fees) and its /previous (2026) and study.csu.edu.au/international/course-fees (2026): row '<CRICOS> <name> <location> $<per 8pt subject> $<annual 8 subjects>' -> fee = second amount after {code}. 2026-year table pages and Study Abroad 6-month rows are excluded from fee. (3) handbook.csu.edu.au pages are browser-rendered (needs_render) and not read. English: central page https://study.csu.edu.au/international/how-to-apply/course-entry-requirements. No term_months needed: course pages print session start dates.
